summary: Implement CS-CLOUD-IAM-002: a pure-domain immutable metadata-only Cloud IAM IdP registry evidence event and receipt conversion from provider sync receipts, with tenant/provider binding, allowlisted evidence refs, schema validation, and API error mapping for provider mismatch.

baseline_diff.before: CS-CLOUD-IAM-001 persisted metadata-only IdP registry snapshots, but provider sync receipts did not yet convert to a dedicated Cloud IAM evidence event/receipt shape.
baseline_diff.after: Cloud IAM domain exposes IdentityProviderRegistryEvidenceEvent and IdentityProviderRegistryEvidenceReceipt. Event fields are private with read-only accessors, carry tenant/actor/provider/operation/status/evidence/idempotency/schema metadata, and reject tenant mismatch, provider mismatch, missing or token-shaped evidence refs, and receipt schema drift.

best_practice_research.question: Hyperscaler IAM evidence-event pattern for IdP federation receipt metadata.
best_practice_research.version_date_context: Reused official/upstream research validated 2026-05-23 in CS-CLOUD-IAM-001 evidence.

official_upstream_sources.establishes: Federation, temporary credentials, MFA, least privilege, and periodic review are IAM baselines.
Temporary credentials are short-lived and should avoid embedded/distributed long-term secrets.
External identity impersonation should be specific and least-privilege.
Identity domains include SSO, SAML/OAuth IdP administration, MFA/security settings, and administrative isolation.
Evidence-based reliability/rollout decisions should use measured SLIs/SLOs and avoid absolute promises.

best_practice_research.implementation_handoff: Evidence events must carry references and decision metadata only, never provider documents, credentials, assertions, or STS material.

findings: The change adds one immutable value event and receipt conversion; no storage adapter, network, filesystem, clock, or provider SDK dependency is introduced.
Event creation preserves external IdP federation evidence references and short-lived credential boundaries without storing token material.
Regression test rejects tenant mismatch, provider mismatch, missing evidence refs, token-shaped evidence refs, and receipt schema drift.
Read-only accessors make event contents explicit while preventing external field mutation.
Targeted and package Cloud IAM tests passed; API error mapping remains exhaustive after adding ProviderMismatch.

alternatives_named: Emit directly to audit-chain domain now
Add pure metadata event and receipt conversion first
F6_alternatives.selected_rationale: Pure conversion is the smallest clean-architecture slice; audit-chain app/adapter wiring can follow without leaking provider material into outer storage decisions.

findings: Evidence refs must use allowlisted opaque schemes; token-shaped evidence material is rejected; event type has no raw provider, credential, assertion, or STS material fields.
Event creation is deterministic string/value validation over one receipt; no I/O or allocation-heavy collection scans.
Evidence bundle includes matching audit-chain JSONL coverage row for this ChangeSet id.
Additive domain/API/todo/evidence change; revert removes event conversion without migration or external state.
Evidence event carries event id, tenant, provider request id, evidence ref, idempotency key, status, and occurred timestamp for later audit-chain binding.
No public wire contract or database migration is introduced; API mapping updated only for new domain error exhaustiveness.
New types follow IdentityProviderRegistry* naming from CS-CLOUD-IAM-001.
Domain remains pure; API maps errors only.
Focused evidence-event regression plus Cloud IAM package tests passed.
Multispectrum evidence and audit-chain JSONL coverage are created for CS-CLOUD-IAM-002.

remaining_risks: Concrete audit-chain emitter/app adapter wiring remains future work; this slice only creates the pure domain evidence event/receipt conversion.
Full repo verify is not rerun for this small follow-up because CS-CLOUD-IAM-001 already documented repo-wide global failures unrelated to Cloud IAM scoped tests.
